15. From a basket full of eggs, 20% of the eggs broke,8% were rotten and 24% were kept aside for baking a cake. The remaining 12 eggs were consumed by some people. How many eggs were there in the basket initially?

15.(a)

Let the total no of eggs be 100 unit

Then, no of broken eggs = 20 unit

No of rotten eggs = 8 unit

No of eggs kept for baking cake = 24 unit

Remaining no of eggs = 100 - (20+8+24) = 100 - 52 = 48 unit

ATQ,

48 unit = 12

1 unit = 1248=14

Then, 100 unit = 14 × 100 = 25

Hence, the total no of eggs = 25

questions.q:
In an election between A and B, every fourth vote polled was marked as invalid by the machine. In the remaining votes, B wins the election with a margin of 2400 votes or 5% of the total votes polled over A. If 80% of the invalid votes would have been in favor of A, then which of the following would have been the result of the election?

A और B के बीच हुए चुनाव में, हर चौथे वोट को मशीन द्वारा अवैध घोषित कर दिया गया। शेष वोटों में, B, A पर डाले गए कुल वोटों के 5% या 2400 वोटों के अंतर से चुनाव जीतता है। यदि 80% अवैध वोट A के पक्ष में होते, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा चुनाव का परिणाम होता?
o: B would have won by 7.25%B 7.25% से जीत जाता
A would have won by 15%A 15% से जीत जाता
B would have won by 6%B 6% से जीत जाता
A would have won by 17.25%A 17.25% से जीत जाता
questions.s:
The total number of votes polled = 2400 * 100/5 = 48000

Total number of invalid votes = 48000/4 = 12000

Total number of valid votes = 36000

Let the total valid votes got to A be 'X'

The total valid votes got to B be 'X + 2400'

A/Q

X + X + 2400 = 36000

X = 16800

Number of valid votes B gets = 16800 + 2400 = 19200

80% of invalid votes = 12000 * 80/100 = 9600

Total votes A get = 16800 + 9600 = 26400

So, A would have won by = (26400 - 19200) * 100/48000 = 15%
